battle.name: 河間之戰
battle.brief: 隋大業十三年（617）冬，竇建德率河北聯軍攻隋河間郡治安喜（今河北定州），圍城久攻不下。隋郡兵據堅城以弩砲、檑石、火油與長矛層層拒守，攻城者屢登屢敗。卡面羅馬短劍（Gladius）在此無機會出手：短兵刺擊，夠不到雲梯上的守軍，河間這場仗全在刀劍射程之外分勝負。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 交戰雙方：一方是隋朝河間郡的官軍。河間郡屬冀州，治安喜，是隋廷在河北中部僅存的一批有組織武裝力量，由郡丞率領，兵力來自郡兵、縣兵與鎮兵，編制上仍隸尚書省與兵部，武器裝備多沿北周以來府兵遺制：步卒持矛、戟、槊，騎兵披甲佩橫刀，弓弩與床弩分置城頭與軍中，糧秣靠郡內豐州縣的稅糧與徵發。另一方是竇建德率領的河北聯軍。竇建德以漳南農民起義為班底，收編河北各地起義殘部、降隋的官軍與散卒，騎兵比例在各部中最高，號令統一，作戰以流動作戰見長，但攻城器械與遠程火力遠不如郡兵。當時河北三方勢力並立：竇建德居南、羅藝守幽州、劉黑闥據燕州，隋朝只剩下河間等數座城仍在官軍手中，河間郡實際上是隋廷在河北最後的堡壘。
countriesEn: The two sides were: on one side, the government troops of Hejian commandery under the Sui. Hejian belonged to Jizhou and was seated at Anxi, and it was one of the last bodies of organised military force the Sui court still held in central Hebei. It was led by the deputy administrator of the commandery, and its soldiers came from the commandery levies, the county levies and the garrison troops, formally subordinated to the Department of State Affairs and the Ministry of War. Its arms and equipment still followed the fubing system inherited from Northern Zhou: infantry carried spears, halberds and the sao-polearm, armoured cavalry rode with sabres at the belt, and bows, crossbows and bedded crossbows were distributed between the walls and the field, while grain came from the tax stores of the well-stocked counties inside the commandery. On the other side stood the Hebei coalition of Dou Jiande. Dou Jiande built his force on the peasant insurgents of the south of Zhang, absorbing the remnants of uprisings from all over Hebei together with surrendered Sui soldiers and stragglers; cavalry formed the largest arm of that host, orders were strict, and the army was at its best in fluid operations, but in siege engines and long-range firepower it fell far behind the commandery garrison. Three powers stood in Hebei at that moment: Dou Jiande in the south, Luo Yi holding Youzhou in the north and Liu Heitao at Yanzhou between them. Of the Sui administrative order only a few walled cities such as Hejian remained in the hands of official troops, and Hejian was in practice the last redoubt of the Sui house in Hebei.
people: 關鍵人物：竇建德是這場戰役的主攻方，河北人，以漳南鄉里武裝起家，靠縱騎奔襲、遊走切割練出一支號令嚴整的騎兵，對歸附的鄉里部眾厚待，河北依附者眾，故能以聯軍之眾年年吞併各部。他用兵向來避實擊虛、避重就輕，野戰堪稱刁悍，對堅城卻缺乏攻城器械與持久圍城的準備，這一短板在河間暴露無遺。守方主將是河間郡丞，其姓名在《資治通鑑》與《隋書》中均未詳載，此戰之後也不見於仕宦傳記，只在郡一級的地方記載中留痕。隋廷在河北最後成建制的官軍精銳是名將張須陀所部，他在大業十四年正月與竇建德決戰時全軍覆沒而身死，河北的隋室旗籍由此斷絕。劉黑闥原為幽州羅藝部將，河北歸唐之後再舉兵，與竇建德先合後分，最終同為唐軍所滅。李淵、李世民父子同期在太原起兵建唐，河北之爭是他們西向統一之外的另一條戰線，李世民於武德五年漳南生擒竇建德、洺水擊潰劉黑闥，河北才真正歸於唐。
peopleEn: The key figures: Dou Jiande was the attacker. A Hebei native, he began as a local armed band in the country south of Zhang and made his name by running cavalry raids and cutting the enemy up in the open, training a disciplined mounted force and treating the rural followers who came over to him generously, which is why so much of Hebei joined him and he could swallow up the other bands year by year with a coalition host. In the field he was always at his best, avoiding strongpoints and striking the weak, and he was deadly on the open plain, but against a fortress wall he lacked both siege engines and the preparation for a protracted investment; that shortfall showed itself completely at Hejian. The Sui commander was the deputy administrator of Hejian commandery, whose name is recorded neither in the Zizhi Tongjian nor in the histories of the Sui; he appears in no later biographical notice either, and only a trace of him survives in the local records of the commandery. The last fully organised body of Sui troops in Hebei was the army of the famous general Zhang Xutuo, who was destroyed and killed when he fought his set-piece battle against Dou Jiande in the first month of 618, and with that the Sui banners in Hebei were extinguished. Liu Heitao had been a general under Luo Yi at Youzhou; after Hebei passed to the Tang he raised his banners again, first joining and then quarrelling with Dou Jiande, and the two were finally destroyed by Tang armies. Li Yuan and his son Li Shimin had risen at Taiyuan and founded the Tang at the same moment, and the contest for Hebei was a second front alongside the westward unification they were pursuing; Li Shimin took Dou Jiande alive at Zhangnan and broke Liu Heitao at Mingshui in 622, and only then did Hebei truly pass to the Tang.
kits: 卡面兵器是羅馬短劍（Gladius），約公元前一百年的羅馬制式刺擊短劍，重約一公斤，刃長不及半尺，柄短而握持靠後，護手幾與握柄同寬，真正的用法是雙手持握、以肩臂推送完成一次直線刺擊，而不是橫掃劈砍；羅馬人把它配在大方盾之後，節奏是先合盾、後出劍，整排同時刺出，形成正面難以承受的牆面。但河間的幾何擺明了它派不上用場：短劍的有效射程不到半米，攻城方要碰到守軍，必須先讓人沿雲梯爬上一人多高的牆頭，而那一段距離整段都在城頭弩砲、檑石與火油的射程之內；守軍退回城頭甬道以後，短劍仍然用得著，可那一刻攻城兵早已被弩矢與落石擋在牆外。就器材而言，隋軍步卒用長矛與戟構成拒馬，佩於腰間的短刀是最後一線的刺擊兵器；隋唐出土的制式長刀陌刀，長約二尺有奇，單刃厚背，同樣兼顧劈砍與刺入。河間之戰裡雙方能用的器物大致如此：隋軍有弓、臂張弩與蹶張弩、城頭弩砲（床弩）、拒馬、鹿角、檑石與火油，攻城一方的竇建德有雲梯、撞車、飛樓與臨時土築的攻城台，卻缺乏能持續壓制城頭的攻城砲與重覆甲兵馬；雙方都沒有火砲。戰馬方面，隋軍騎兵多披甲而不披馬鎧，竇建德的騎兵靠河北所產的馬匹輪換作戰，人力與戰馬的消耗都極為可觀。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman gladius, the standard Roman thrusting short sword of about 100 BC: it weighs roughly a kilogram, its blade is well under half a foot long, the grip is short and held toward the rear, and the pommel is barely wider than the hand. Its real use is a two-handed straight thrust driven by the shoulder and the arm, not a sideways cut. The Romans carried it behind the large scutum, and the rhythm was shield first and sword second, the whole line stabbing out together to form a face an opponent could not easily absorb. At Hejian, however, the geometry of the siege ruled it out: a short sword has an effective reach of less than half a metre, and for an attacker to reach a defender he first has to climb a ladder to a wall head higher than a man, and that whole stretch of the climb lies inside the beaten zone of the wall-top crossbows, the stones and the boiling oil. Once the defenders withdrew into the wall-head passages the short sword would have been usable again, but by then the attackers had already been kept outside the wall by bolts and falling stones. As for the rest of the equipment, the Sui infantry formed a refusing line of spears and halberds, and the short sword worn at the belt was the thrusting arm of last resort; the standard long sabre of the Sui and Tang, the modao, is a little over two feet long, single edged and thick backed, and serves both cutting and stabbing in one piece. The weapons actually available at Hejian were of this kind. The Sui had bows, hand and foot crossbows, bedded crossbows on the walls, cheval-de-frise, abatis, stones and boiling oil; the besiegers under Dou Jiande had ladders, battering rams, siege towers and hastily raised earthen platforms, but no artillery able to keep the walls silenced and no heavily armoured cavalry; neither side had gunpowder artillery. As for mounts, the Sui cavalry were armoured but their horses generally were not, and Dou Jiande's horsemen relied on the large numbers of horses raised in Hebei, so men and animals were consumed at a fearsome rate.
tactics: 戰術：這是一場典型的攻堅與固守之戰。竇建德一方出自流動作戰的起義軍，慣於騎兵在野地奔馳切割、斷糧、疲敵，但要拿下河間這樣的州城，就得改為圍城：先以步兵結陣逼近城牆，填平壕溝、架雲梯、造飛樓、擡撞車，同時在城外築土山居高臨下射擊城頭，並派騎兵遮斷官軍自太原、幽州方向可能來援的通道，糧道與援兵同時掐斷。守方的部署則完全倚城垣而建：城頭分層布防，弩砲壓制城外逼近的密集隊形，弓手在垛口下射擊攀城者，檑石與火油封住雲梯落點，士卒在城門內列陣，以長矛與戟堵住突破口；出城反擊只選夜裡或陰雨天，以少量精騎焚毀攻城器械後立即撤回，不與攻城方糾纏。冬季是這一戰最難熬的部分：十一月以後太行山東麓滴水成冰，凍土使壕溝難挖、攻城台難築，糧秣消耗卻急升，而河間距長安近兩千里，距最近的大郡郡治也在數百里外，城外竇建德軍的補給同樣要靠河北鄉村逐村徵發。兩軍真正的較量，最後落在誰能先耗盡對方的糧與體力上。
tacticsEn: The tactics: this was a classic siege against a determined defence. Dou Jiande's side grew out of the fluid warfare of the insurgents, used to sending cavalry out across the plain to cut, to sever supply and to wear the enemy down, but to take a prefectural city such as Hejian it had to settle down to a siege: infantry drawn up to close on the wall, ditches filled in, ladders raised, siege towers built, battering rams carried forward, earthen platforms thrown up outside so the archers could shoot down into the town, and cavalry posted to cut off any relief column that might come from Taiyuan or Youzhou, choking both the supply line and the prospect of reinforcement. The defence was built entirely on the walls: the parapet was held in tiers, bedded crossbows overawing the dense formations massing under the wall, archers shooting from under the crenellations at the men on the ladders, stones and boiling oil sealing the points where the ladders landed, and troops drawn up inside the gates with spears and halberds to plug any breach. S sorties went out only by night or in wet weather, small bodies of picked cavalry setting fire to the siege works and falling straight back rather than being drawn into a brawl. Winter was the hardest part of the whole business: after the eleventh month the eastern foothills of the Taihang froze hard, frozen ground made ditches hard to dig and platforms hard to raise, yet the consumption of grain climbed, and Hejian lies nearly two thousand li from Chang'an and several hundred li from the nearest great commandery seat, so the besiegers' food had to be squeezed out of the villages of Hebei one by one. What the two armies really measured against each other was which of them could exhaust the enemy's grain and bodies first.
data: 數字：有關此戰的記錄極簡，只能從相關史籍中提取有限且互相參差的數字。時間上，戰事發生在隋大業十三年（617）冬，通常繫於十一月至十二月之間，隋煬帝仍在位，唐室尚未建立。地理上，河間郡治安喜在今河北定州一帶，北距幽州涿郡約三百五十里，南至趙郡約二百里，向西出井陘關至太原約六百里；城為夯土築就，外有壕溝與甕城，周長約數里，控太行山東麓出入河北的孔道。兵員上，竇建德聯軍的總兵力史書多概稱十餘萬，但這是對河北起義各部人數的合併概括；河北連年戰亂，戶口大量死亡流亡，能實際調集於河間城下者應遠少於此數。相較之下，隋廷在河間一郡能倚的郡兵、縣兵與鎮兵，總數不過數千之數。兩相比較，攻城一方在兵力上佔優，守方在城防與守備上佔優。損失數字無從確考，唯可注意者，是翌年（大業十四年，618）正月，張須陀部在漳水下游一線與竇建德決戰時全軍覆沒，被擄與陣亡合計以數萬計，器械資儲盡失——河北官軍的最終崩潰並非在河間城下，而是在野戰中完成。
dataEn: The figures: the record of this battle is extremely thin, and only a limited and mutually inconsistent set of numbers can be drawn from the relevant histories. In time, the fighting belongs to the winter of the thirteenth year of the Dayi era (617), usually placed between the eleventh and twelfth months, when Emperor Yang of Sui was still alive and the Tang had not yet been founded. In geography, the seat Anxi of Hejian commandery lies in the area of today's Dingzhou in Hebei, roughly three hundred and fifty li north of Youzhou at Zhu commandery and some two hundred li south of Zhao commandery, with about six hundred li on to Taiyuan through the Jingxing pass; the city was rammed earth, with a moat and barbican outside, a circuit of a few li, and it controlled the gateways through which Hebei was entered from the east of the Taihang. On troops, the total strength of Dou Jiande's coalition is usually given in the histories as a hundred thousand and more, but that is a summary figure covering all the rebel bands of Hebei; after years of war in the north, with large loss of life and flight of population, the men actually able to assemble before Hejian must have been far fewer. By contrast, the commandery, county and garrison levies that the Sui could still rely on inside Hejian numbered only some thousands. The two sides were therefore unequal in a way: the besiegers had the advantage in numbers, the defenders in fortification and readiness. Casualty figures cannot be established; the one point worth noting is that in the first month of the following year (day fourteen of Dayi, 618) Zhang Xutuo's army was annihilated in a battle on the lower reaches of the Zhang river, with tens of thousands killed or taken prisoner and all its stores and equipment lost. The final collapse of the Sui army in Hebei therefore did not happen under the walls of Hejian, but in the open field.
cause: 起因：大業年間的亂局把河間推到了風口上。自大業七年（611）高句麗之役起，隋朝的丁口、府兵與國庫一齊崩解，河北一帶的賦役被加到極限，民變蜂起：大業九年前後竇建德在漳南首義，其後張覺、張益武等部在河北舉兵，隋廷遣將追剿，張覺、張益武先後伏誅，另有高句麗、靺鞨方向的流民與亡命沿太行山道湧入河北，每一場剿匪戰役都把更多的郡兵、鄉勇推向盜匪一邊。竇建德正是在這片土壤上聚眾坐大，到大業十三年已成為河北最大的軍事集團。對他來說，河間郡不是一座可以繞開的城：安喜踞太行東麓要衝，向西控制井陘口，向北可窺幽州，向南直抵趙郡，是把河北南北連成一體的樞紐；取了河間，河北殘存的官軍據點便被連根拔除。反過來，守方的處境同樣絕望：大業十三年時，隋廷可調的中央精銳已多被抽往關中與江都一線，河北能戰者只剩張須陀所部與各郡郡兵，糧餉要自籌，援兵指望不上。城守與城破，只看誰先耗盡對方的糧秣。
causeEn: The causes: the disorder of the Dayi era pushed Hejian onto the front line. Since the Goguryeo campaign of the seventh year of Dayi (611) the Sui had lost its population, its fubing and its treasury all at once, and the taxation and corvée burden in Hebei was pushed to the limit, so that risings broke out all over. Dou Jiande raised his first banner in the country south of Zhang around the ninth year of Dayi; afterwards bands such as those of Zhang Jue and Zhang Yiwu rose in Hebei, and the court sent generals after them, with Zhang Jue and Zhang Yiwu executed in turn, while fugitives and displaced men from the Goguryeo and Mohe directions poured into Hebei along the roads over the Taihang. Every campaign against the rebels pushed more and more of the commandery levies and local militia over to the bandits, and on that soil Dou Jiande massed his following and grew into by far the largest military group in Hebei. For him Hejian was not a city that could be walked around: Anxi sat astride the eastern approach of the Taihang, commanding the Jingxing pass to the west, looking towards Youzhou to the north and reaching down to Zhao commandery to the south, and it was the hinge that bound the north and south of Hebei together. Take Hejian and the last Sui strongpoints in the province would be cut out at the root. The defenders' situation was just as desperate: by the thirteenth year of Dayi the central fighting strength of the Sui had been drawn off to Guanzhong and Jiangdu, the only organised force left to fight in Hebei was Zhang Xutuo's army and the commandery levies, grain had to be raised locally and no relief could be expected. Whether the city held or fell came down to which side exhausted the other's grain first.
impact: 影響：這一戰的直接結果，是河間這座河北樞紐城沒有在隋末的混戰中立刻易手，隋廷在河北僅存的合法統治多延續了一段時間；而從更長的視角看，它也把隋朝最後的崩解過程攤在明面上——隋的郡兵仍能守城，卻已無力反攻、無糧可支、無援可待，中樞的命令到了河間只剩下守字。這種地方自守、中樞失能的狀態，正是隋末群雄得以在各自地盤上建立割據政權的制度前提。此後的走向被這場戰役的結局所決定：隋亡唐興，河北的歸屬要看唐與竇建德的角力，武德五年（622）李世民在漳南生擒竇建德、洺水之役擊潰劉黑闥，河北才納入唐的版圖；河間郡隨之改置定州，設總管府，成為唐北方防禦突厥與契丹的前沿重鎮，其後安史之亂時又是唐軍北運的關鍵節點。裝備層面上，河間的攻防也為隋唐的軍器定型提供了樣本：城頭弩砲、步騎合用的長刀與短刀、攻城用的雲梯與撞車，都沿著這一時期的樣式傳承下去，而羅馬短劍所代表的以刺為主、刀作最後兵器的分寸感，正是這條技術線上最樸素的源頭之一。
impactEn: The impact: the direct result was that Hejian, the hinge of Hebei, did not change hands at once amid the wars of the late Sui, and the last legal Sui rule over the province was prolonged a little further. Seen from a longer angle, the battle also laid the final collapse of the Sui bare: the commandery levies could still hold a city, but they had no strength left to counterattack, no grain to feed a campaign and no relief to wait for, and the orders of the central government had shrunk to a single word when they reached Hejian, hold. This condition, in which the localities defended themselves while the centre lost its power, was the institutional precondition for the rebel leaders of the late Sui to build their own separatist regimes on their own ground. What followed was decided by the outcome of this battle: the Sui fell and the Tang rose, and the ownership of Hebei came down to the struggle between the Tang and Dou Jiande, until in 622 Li Shimin took Dou Jiande alive at Zhangnan and broke Liu Heitao in the battle of Mingshui, and Hebei was folded into the Tang empire. Hejian commandery was then reorganised as Dingzhou with a headquarters of a commander-in-chief, becoming a forward garrison of the Tang against the Turks and Khitans, and later a vital node in the northern supply lines of the Tang armies during the An Lushan rebellion. At the level of equipment, the siege and defence of Hejian also furnished a model for the standardisation of Sui and Tang ordnance: bedded crossbows on the walls, long and short sabres used by infantry and cavalry alike, ladders and battering rams used in the assault all passed on in the forms of this period, and the sense of measure represented by the Roman gladius, a thrust in place of a cut and the sword kept back as the weapon of last resort, is one of the plainest sources of that line of technical development.
result: 結果：竇建德未能攻下河間。圍城在隋大業十三年冬陷入僵持，攻城方缺少能壓制城頭的火力與能持久支撐的攻城器械，守方雖無援兵、糧秣全靠郡內自給，仍憑城垣、弩砲與長矛把每一次登城都打成血肉相磨，戰役因此沒有分出勝負而以退兵收場。竇建德把兵鋒轉向河北其它方向，翌年（618）隋室崩潰，宇文化及弒煬帝、李淵建唐，河北先後歸於劉黑闥與竇建德的夏政權，兩者先後與唐衝突，武德五年（622）唐軍擒竇建德於漳南、破劉黑闥於洺水，河間隨之易主，隋代河間郡改唐之定州，設總管府，成為唐朝北方重鎮。需要說明的是，此役的史料極為疏略：《隋書》與《資治通鑑》只在編年與人物傳中略述其概貌，雙方兵員、陣亡、被擄與攻城器械的數目均無可靠記載，卡面這具羅馬短劍（Gladius）與此戰並無任何實物關係，它在此標示的反而是一種射程上的侷限：不到半米的刺擊武器，在一場攻城與守城都靠遠程器械定勝負的戰鬥裡，根本沒有出手的機會。
resultEn: The result: Dou Jiande failed to take Hejian. The siege bogged down in the winter of the thirteenth year of Dayi. The besiegers lacked firepower able to dominate the walls and lacked siege engines that could be sustained; the defenders, though they had no relief army and drew their grain entirely from within the commandery, still made every attempt on the wall a grind of blood and stone, using the ramparts, the bedded crossbows and the spears. The battle therefore decided nothing and closed with a withdrawal. Dou Jiande turned his force towards other parts of Hebei. In the following year (618) the Sui collapsed, Yuwen Huaji murdered Emperor Yang and Li Yuan founded the Tang; Hebei passed in turn to Liu Heitao and to Dou Jiande's Xia regime, and both came into conflict with the Tang. In 622 the Tang took Dou Jiande alive at Zhangnan and broke Liu Heitao at Mingshui, and Hejian changed hands with them; the Sui commandery of Hejian became the Tang prefecture of Dingzhou with a headquarters of a commander-in-chief, a northern stronghold of the dynasty. It must be said that the sources for this battle are very thin: the histories of the Sui and the Zizhi Tongjian give only a summary of it in their annals and in the biographical notices, and there is no reliable record of the numbers engaged, killed, taken prisoner or of the siege engines used on either side. The Roman gladius on the card has no material connection with this battle whatever; what it marks here is a limit of reach: a thrusting weapon of less than half a metre had no opportunity to be drawn in a fight decided at range by artillery and by the walls themselves.
